ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the central and medial regions, and 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches and irregular mottling are strictly mapped to the outer lateral tips of both lobes. The interior fluke area from the median notch to the mid-lobes exhibits a solid, low-intensity black pigmentation map.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees, dividing the fluke lobes symmetrically.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations identified along the entire trailing edge boundary. Discrete sharp peaks and valleys are most pronounced in the medial-to-lateral transition zones of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a steep upward taper (concave-out) at the distal lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme lateral tips and intermittently along the trailing edge serration peaks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected vertically on the mid-left lobe and diagonally on the lower-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at both distal tips; distinct deep jagged notches on the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe potentially indicating minor historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, small white ring-shaped mark with a dark-pixel center (target-like feature) is visible on the inner-right lobe's ventral surface.
